name: prinfer

tools.name: hover_by_name
tools.description: The type TypeScript infers for a named variable, function, parameter, property, or type. Use before writing an annotation, when unsure what a generic or call resolves to, or instead of reading .d.ts files.

file.description: TS/JS file: absolute, or relative to the server's cwd

line.description: 1-based line, to pick among repeated names

max_chars.description: Text cap per type (default 4000 chars; 0: none)

project.description: tsconfig.json; default: the nearest one above file

backend.description: Default typescript7; retry with typescript6 if it fails or looks wrong

tools.name: hover
tools.description: The type at a token on a line, like an editor hover; generic calls show their instantiated types. Use when hover_by_name can't name the token: callback parameters, expressions, repeated names.

file.description: TS/JS file: absolute, or relative to the server's cwd

text.description: Token copied from the line, e.g. "useState"; whole identifiers match first. Instead of column

occurrence.description: Which match of text on the line (default 1)

max_chars.description: Text cap per type (default 4000 chars; 0: none)

project.description: tsconfig.json; default: the nearest one above file

backend.description: Default typescript7; retry with typescript6 if it fails or looks wrong

tools.name: batch_hover
tools.description: Up to 100 hovers in one call, across files. Items: {name, line?}, {line, text, occurrence?}, or {line, column}; failures are per item.

file.description: Shared file for items without one

text.description: Token copied from the line, e.g. "useState"; whole identifiers match first. Instead of column

occurrence.description: Which match of text on the line (default 1)

max_chars.description: Text cap per type (default 4000 chars; 0: none)

project.description: tsconfig.json; default: the nearest one above file

backend.description: Default typescript7; retry with typescript6 if it fails or looks wrong

tools.name: completions
tools.description: The completions TypeScript offers at a cursor, including string-literal union members. Use to find valid values for an argument, key, or import before writing it. Returns the top 50.

file.description: TS/JS file: absolute, or relative to the server's cwd

column.description: 1-based column; the cursor sits before it, e.g. just inside an opening quote

prefix.description: Name prefix, case-insensitive; default: the text left of the cursor; "" lists all

project.description: tsconfig.json; default: the nearest one above file

tools.name: diagnostics
tools.description: Check one file for type errors without running tsc on the whole project. Call it on each file you edit; the edit is done when none reports an error.

file.description: TS/JS file: absolute, or relative to the server's cwd

project.description: tsconfig.json; default: the nearest one above file

include_suggestions.description: Also report suggestions such as unused variables

backend.description: Default typescript7; retry with typescript6 if it fails or looks wrong

tools.name: annotations
tools.description: Type annotations in one file that TypeScript would infer anyway (redundant) or that are wider than the inferred type (widening, often an intended contract). Use when reviewing or cleaning up types.

file.description: TS/JS file: absolute, or relative to the server's cwd

project.description: tsconfig.json; default: the nearest one above file

instructions:
typeprobe shows the types TypeScript infers, as an editor hover would. Look a type up instead of guessing it, reading .d.ts files, or writing an annotation to find out.
- hover_by_name: you know the symbol's name. Start here.
- hover: a token without a unique name; pass its line and text copied from that line.
- batch_hover: several lookups, across files, in one call.
- completions: valid values at a cursor, e.g. string-literal union members.
- diagnostics: type errors in one file; run it on each file you edit.
- annotations: annotations TypeScript would infer anyway, when cleaning up types.
If a call fails or looks wrong on the default TypeScript 7 backend, retry it with backend "typescript6".
Type regression tests: expect(inferredType(import.meta.url, { name })).toMatchInlineSnapshot(), with inferredType from typeprobe/testing.
